title: Warehouse test fixture
briefing: Determine who caused a warehouse death and support the finding with independent evidence.
openingFacts: A worker was found beside a damaged loading platform.

characters.name: Inspector Kim
characters.fallbackReply: Ask me to check the access record.

clues.title: Platform trace
clues.body: The platform had been moved after the incident.

clues.title: Corrected account
clues.body: Alex admits moving the platform after the fatal incident.

leads.title: Check access records
leads.description: Check who entered the loading area.
leads.speech: The access record places Alex at the loading area.

reveals.topic: Confront the platform and access record.
reveals.speech: I caused the fatal incident. I moved the platform afterward to disguise what happened.

resolution.reconstruction: Alex caused the incident and moved the platform to mislead the investigation.
